# Native NTP integration

The native producer uses the prepared common Ports `net/ntp4` source through
`EMBER_NTP_SOURCE`, and the common AutoGen libopts tearoff through
`EMBER_LIBOPTS_SOURCE`. Prepare and verify both using the Ports source owners.
The NTP keyword generator is a host program built from the selected NTP source
and the parser header generated by the same native build. The inactive old
`dist` tree is retained temporarily during migration and is not a fallback.

Target compilation and ordinary `ntpd`/`ntpq` startup do not prove time
synchronization, physical reference-clock support or a completed OS release.
